field_mapping.entry_price_log_ratio: log(current_market_mark / avg_entry_price) when non-flat; frozen flat encoding otherwise
field_mapping.margin_utilization_fraction: margin_used / (margin_used + recovered AccountState.available_margin at current mark)
field_mapping.risk_budget_remaining_fraction: snapshot.observation_support_state.risk_budget_remaining / risk_budget_capacity; external authority preserved, not synthesized

risk_budget_note: The physics adapter refuses to invent a historical risk-budget depletion rule because none exists in the recovered kernel. Risk state is part of the composite authoritative snapshot and must be synchronized by its owning risk supervisor.
scale_contract: identical to frozen AccountStatePacketV1 encoder; float32 payload + 7 validity flags; no clipping
